entity.summary: Global centralized cryptocurrency exchange launched in 2018 and headquartered in the United Arab Emirates. Bybit remained active after its February 2025 hot-wallet theft and expanded regulated European operations after Bybit EU GmbH received Austrian MiCAR authorization in May 2025.
entity.notes: The Austrian MiCAR authorization applies specifically to Bybit EU GmbH and its EEA-facing services, not to every global Bybit product or jurisdiction. The February 2025 security incident is already represented by existing event records and is not duplicated here.

events.title: Bybit EU GmbH received Austrian MiCAR authorization
events.description: Austria's Financial Market Authority granted Bybit EU GmbH authorization as a crypto-asset service provider under MiCAR for custody, exchange, placing, and transfer services, supporting Bybit's regulated EEA platform rollout.
events.notes: The authorization is scoped to Bybit EU GmbH and the services listed by the Austrian FMA.

events.title: Bybit Ethereum multisig cold-wallet compromise causes approximately USD 1.46 billion loss
events.description: On February 21, 2025, attackers compromised Bybit's Ethereum multisig cold-wallet signing workflow through a malicious Safe{Wallet} interface and diverted assets across 39 addresses. Bybit's post-incident reconstruction reports 401,347 ETH, 90,375 stETH, 15,000 cmETH and 8,000 mETH, together valued at approximately USD 1.46 billion on the incident date. Bybit stated customer assets remained backed and withdrawals were restored, but this report does not independently audit customer reimbursement. The FBI later attributed the attack to North Korean TraderTraitor actors. This incident is separate from Binance's October 2026 security event.
events.amount_text: Approx. USD 1.46 billion at the February 2025 incident date; 401,347 ETH + 90,375 stETH + 15,000 cmETH + 8,000 mETH
events.notes: Bybit primary analysis and FBI attribution. Do not reuse the historical fiat value at October 2026 prices; nor treat the North Korea attribution in the separate Binance incident as official confirmation based on this 2025 Bybit report.
